@[reducible] def Conjecture989.Mat : ℕ → Type :=
fun d => Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ
@[reducible] def Conjecture989.MatrixMap : ℕ → Type :=
fun d => Conjecture989.Mat d →ₗ[ℂ] Conjecture989.Mat d
def Conjecture989.Positive : {d : ℕ} → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → Prop :=
fun {d} Φ => ∀ (A : Conjecture989.Mat d), Matrix.PosSemidef A → Matrix.PosSemidef (Φ A)
def Conjecture989.block : {k d : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin k × Fin d) (Fin k × Fin d) ℂ → Fin k → Fin k → Conjecture989.Mat d :=
fun {k d} X a b i j => X (a, i) (b, j)
def Conjecture989.amplification : {d : ℕ} →
  Conjecture989.MatrixMap d →
    (k : ℕ) → Matrix (Fin k × Fin d) (Fin k × Fin d) ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin k × Fin d) (Fin k × Fin d) ℂ :=
fun {d} Φ k => { toFun := fun X a b => Φ (Conjecture989.block X a.1 b.1) a.2 b.2, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }
def Conjecture989.CompletelyPositive : {d : ℕ} → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → Prop :=
fun {d} Φ =>
  ∀ (k : ℕ),
    0 < k →
      ∀ (X : Matrix (Fin k × Fin d) (Fin k × Fin d) ℂ), X.PosSemidef → ((Conjecture989.amplification Φ k) X).PosSemidef
def Conjecture989.transposeMap : (d : ℕ) → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d :=
fun d => ↑(Matrix.transposeLinearEquiv (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ ℂ)
def Conjecture989.Decomposable : {d : ℕ} → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → Prop :=
fun {d} Φ =>
  ∃ S T,
    Conjecture989.CompletelyPositive S ∧ Conjecture989.CompletelyPositive T ∧ Φ = S + Conjecture989.transposeMap d ∘ₗ T
def Conjecture989.Indecomposable : {d : ℕ} → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → Prop :=
fun {d} Φ => Conjecture989.Positive Φ ∧ ¬Conjecture989.Decomposable Φ
def Conjecture989.matrixUnit : {d : ℕ} → Fin d → Fin d → Conjecture989.Mat d :=
fun {d} i j => Matrix.stdBasisMatrix i j 1
def Conjecture989.choiMatrix : {d : ℕ} → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → Matrix (Fin d × Fin d) (Fin d × Fin d) ℂ :=
fun {d} Φ a b => Φ (Conjecture989.matrixUnit a.1 b.1) a.2 b.2
def Conjecture989.choiRank : {d : ℕ} → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → ℕ :=

def Conjecture989.ConjecturedMember : (d : ℕ) → Conjecture989.MatrixMap d → Prop :=

source_declaration_inventory.method: Line-based independent declaration scan after masking comments/strings, tracking namespaces and sections. Simple guillemet-quoted components such as «prefix» normalize to logical names. Anonymous/private or unsupported quoted declarations require explicit review rather than silent omission.

proof_bypass_scan.method: Lexical scan after masking nested block comments, line comments, and string literals; raw matches retained for inspection.

execution_audit_scope: Fresh independent build and trust/identity verification; separate from the independent semantic review.

complete_environment_audit.method: Enumerate imported environment constants by actual originating module; emit full type, declaration kind, safety flags and transitive collectAxioms result for every constant. No name-prefix filter or silent exclusion.
complete_environment_audit.compiler_runtime_note: All runtime constants remain included and axiom-audited; _cstage1/_cstage2 compiler outputs are distinguished from safe kernel-level authored declarations.
